name: TinyLaunch

sources.title: TinyLaunch homepage — launch board with daily ranking
TinyLaunch pricing — Standard free vs Premium $39, submission service $279, featured spots
TinyLaunch for agents — JSON API, OTP email login, llms.txt, OpenAPI, agents.json

conditions: Standard free launch uses the standard queue; the badge and 'high authority backlink' are awarded only to Top-3 ranking products
The dofollow backlink is granted only when you embed the TinyLaunch badge with a dofollow link back to tinylaunch.com on your landing page
requirements: Sign-in required (Submit Product routes through auth; dashboard at /dashboard/startups/new)
Product competes in a launch period for upvotes — Top 3 receives exclusive badges
Agent-native alternative: full JSON API with OAuth-style OTP email login — no API keys; documented at /agents, /llms.txt, /openapi.json, /.well-known/agents.json
preparation: Account credentials (or OTP email login for agent-driven launches)
Product name, tagline, description, logo, category
Badge embed plan — the dofollow badge requirement points BACK to tinylaunch.com
Vote-getting plan if relying on the free tier's Top-3 badge/backlink
workflow: Sign in and submit via 'Submit Product' (/dashboard/startups/new) — or drive it end-to-end via the JSON API documented at /agents
Product enters a launch period and collects upvotes
Top-3 finishers get badges; embedding the badge with a dofollow link to tinylaunch.com grants the high-authority backlink
Premium guarantees the backlink and skips the queue
watchFor: Circular link trade: the 'free' dofollow backlink only materializes if you rank Top 3 AND place a dofollow link to them — most free launches get neither
Premium launches are 'frequently showcased between 3rd and 4th place' — paid placement inside the ranking area
Upsells: AI Visibility Audit $9, Featured Spots $15–$30/week, done-for-you Submission Service $279 for ~110 directories
The /agents page explicitly invites AI submissions via API — this is the intended agent path, not form scraping
countsAsLive: A launch page at tinylaunch.com/launch/<id>-<slug> visible during its launch period and in the launch archive afterward.
unknowns: Standard queue length / scheduling latency for free launches
Whether non-Top-3 free listings keep any link at all
Exact API write endpoints for launching (OpenAPI spec at /openapi.json lists them — not exhaustively reviewed here)
